# Error Handling Checklist: Pilot Review Packet and Lifecycle Snapshot

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009D error, incomplete, warning, redaction, and malformed-evidence requirements are specified clearly enough for implementation.
**Created**: 2026-05-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements complete for representing missing stored task, activity, notification, artifact, quality review, governance, GitHub sync, and smoke-checklist evidence as structured `not_available`, `incomplete`, `deferred`, or warning states instead of invented values? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §Pilot Review Packet]
- [x] CHK002 Are local-only lookalike error outcomes complete for candidates missing stored GitHub linkage, sync proof, linked PR identity, or checklist-backed issue/PR evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-013, Contract §Candidate eligibility contract]
- [x] CHK003 Are publication-failure requirements complete for invalid JSON packet shape, unsafe storage/display content, and missing required pilot identity or sync proof when a packet would otherwise claim `proven`? [Completeness, Contract §Failure And Incomplete States]
- [x] CHK004 Are malformed artifact metadata requirements covered through packet-local `malformed` evidence state, structured warnings, retained safe metadata, and source-map pointers where possible? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Packet Evidence Entry, Contract §Failure And Incomplete States]
- [x] CHK005 Are quarantined and redacted artifact error paths complete for metadata-only locked output, ordinary redacted reads, and no dependence on an admin override for normal reviewer inspection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Contract §Existing API Surface]
- [x] CHK006 Are disabled artifact storage and missing artifact-id requirements complete through existing `503 artifact_store_disabled` and `404 artifact_not_found` route semantics without a new packet-specific error envelope? [Completeness, Plan §Artifact Surface, Contract §Existing API Surface]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Are `missing`, `malformed`, `superseded`, `stale`, `redacted`, `quarantined`, and `oversized` evidence states clearly defined as packet-local rendering values rather than new `task_artifacts` enum values? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Packet Evidence Entry]
- [x] CHK008 Is the line between non-fatal warnings and publication-blocking failures clear enough for implementers to avoid either crashing on optional evidence or publishing unsafe/proven-but-unverified packets? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Failure And Incomplete States]
- [x] CHK009 Are missing proof reasons for local-only and incomplete candidates specific enough to identify whether `github_repo`, `github_issue_number`, `github_synced_at`, `github_pr_number`, or checklist-backed issue/PR evidence is absent? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Candidate eligibility contract]
- [x] CHK010 Are source-map expectations clear for error and warning entries, including when source-map pointers are required and when empty source maps are allowed only for explicit future deferrals? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Source Map Reference]
- [x] CHK011 Are structured warning requirements clear that malformed, stale, superseded, oversized, redacted, and quarantined evidence should include explicit reasons and safe source pointers where possible? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Pilot Review Packet]
- [x] CHK012 Are Markdown error-output safety requirements clear that evidence-derived strings remain untrusted after redaction and must not become raw HTML or active links? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Redaction And Safety, Contract §Markdown Artifact]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do spec, plan, data model, and contract consistently reuse existing task-artifact route responses for locked, missing, disabled, redacted, and superseded artifacts? [Consistency, Plan §Artifact Surface, Contract §Existing API Surface]
- [x] CHK014 Do malformed evidence and malformed artifact metadata requirements align with existing SPEC-007 behavior that preserves rows and metadata while using hashes, byte counts, redaction status, security-scan status, and safe previews? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Prior Spec §SPEC-007]
- [x] CHK015 Do local-only exclusion and incomplete-candidate requirements consistently prevent partial local evidence from being presented as proven pilot completion? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 4, Spec §SC-005, Contract §Candidate eligibility contract]
- [x] CHK016 Do JSON and Markdown error/warning requirements consistently require both artifacts to come from the same source snapshot and avoid contradictions in lifecycle, gate, evidence, deferral, and warning values? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003, Contract §Markdown Artifact]
- [x] CHK017 Do cleaned replay requirements consistently distinguish archived UAT proof from current active Mission Control state so missing live rows produce `not_available` with cleanup rationale rather than false current-state claims? ## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Can SC-002 be objectively evaluated for error and warning paths by requiring every evidence-backed warning, incomplete reason, and selected error claim to have source-map coverage? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK019 Can SC-004 be objectively evaluated for failure paths by proving packet assembly succeeds from stored rows when evidence is present and performs zero required fresh GitHub calls when errors are represented? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]

- [x] CHK021 Can publication failure be objectively evaluated by cases for invalid packet JSON, unsafe-to-store content, and missing required identity/sync proof under a claimed `proven` state? [Acceptance Criteria, Contract §Failure And Incomplete States]
